body.heading: Program the robot
paragraphs: One person is the robot. Robots cannot guess: they only follow exact instructions.
Say: take two steps forward. Turn around. The robot must not add anything extra.

body.heading: Fix the bugs
paragraphs: Try to get the robot across the room to pick up a toy. If the robot walks into a cushion, your instructions need fixing.
Programmers call that debugging. Swap roles and let the new robot be just as literal.

takeaway: Robots do exactly what you say, which is funnier than you expect.
materials: A toy for the robot to fetch
safetyNotes: The robot only moves in safe, clear spaces and stops whenever the programmer says stop.
screenFreeExtension: Program your robot to do a helpful job, like fetching a cushion.
